post_freeze_drift.assessment: The drifted commit is an auto-generated metrics/docs snapshot (DORA + SLO JSON plus the generated CLAIMED_VS_ACTUAL.md). It changes no application code, no build/package configuration and no release workflow, so the artifacts already built, signed/published and verified from the frozen SHA remain the artifacts of record for this release.
post_freeze_drift.decision: The release SHA stays 54325894cc6e3fc2becfcbc98697a099310d9420 for both platforms. Re-targeting the release to the new head would invalidate the Windows three-phase evidence, which was produced against the frozen SHA.
post_freeze_drift.caveat_for_both_platforms: main is no longer byte-identical to the frozen SHA. Anyone re-verifying 'main == release SHA' will now see a mismatch; the mismatch is the metrics-snapshot commit above, not a functional change.

stable_auto_update_feed.decision_record: 业主 2026-09-17 决定：在 2029-09-17（含当日）之前，Windows 企业版安装包允许在未完成 Authenticode 代码签名的情况下公开下载，用限期风险接受替代签名硬门禁。授权范围只有官网下载页的 Windows 临时交付包：安装包与指针文件公开可下载，但 Windows 稳定自动更新通道保持关闭（不写 latest.yml），已安装的未签名版本不会自动升级。到期后授权自动失效，下载发布步骤 fail-closed（构建报错而不是静默降级），需重新评估或补齐签名。证据纪律不变：仍要求精确 release SHA、两日安全扫描对、真实安装冒烟回执。

windows.interim_closure_reason: Unsigned installer (Authenticode=NotSigned) published on the official download page under bounded owner risk acceptance WSA-2026-09-17-01; the Windows stable auto-update feed is explicitly closed (windows_stable_feed=closed, no latest.yml), so installed unsigned builds do not auto-upgrade. FULL_CLOSED is therefore not claimable for Windows.
